name: All Pro Cleaning Services — Bird Cleanup & Holiday Lighting
description: Advertises pigeon-waste and nest cleanup on roofs, gutters and other surfaces, plus a separate seasonal holiday-light design, installation, maintenance and takedown service. Its locations page names Mountain House, Tracy, Lathrop and Manteca with a shared regional phone. Confirm solar-array work separately; no solar exclusion mesh qualification is assumed. Ask for current scope, credentials, availability and a written quote.
